events.title: Edge Stream Connected
events.detail: edge-01 streams 640x480 JPEG frames (q=70) at 5 FPS to POST /frames.

events.title: Owner & Backpack Detected
events.detail: YOLO26n detects person and backpack (conf >= 0.40); Tracker creates track_id=2 bound to owner_id=1.

events.title: Owner Departs Area
events.detail: Owner moves beyond owner_radius (0.20); unattended dwell clock starts counting from last_person_near_ts.

events.title: R2 Unexpected Object Warning
events.detail: Backpack track alive >= 5s; RuleEngine emits unexpected_object warning keyed by ('unexpected_object', 2).

events.title: Passerby Ignored (Anti-Evasion)
events.detail: Non-owner walks past for 1s (< 2s stationary threshold); unattended dwell timer is NOT reset.

events.title: R3 Object Dwell Critical Alarm
events.detail: Unattended time reaches 30s; fires critical alert, console banner, beep, and red frame border.

events.title: Owner Returns Within Radius
events.detail: Bound owner_id=1 returns within 0.20 radius; last_person_near_ts updates and RESETS unattended timer to 0s.

events.title: Object Removed & Track Expired
events.detail: Backpack is carried away; track expires after 15s track_timeout; incident cleared.

cards.title: Owner Binding & Reset Semantics
items: At first_seen (10:00:05), Tracker binds the nearest person within 0.20 radius as owner_id
Transient passersby (< 2s near bag) do not reset the unattended clock
When the bound owner returns (or a guard stands stationary >= 2s), the unattended clock RESETS to 0s

cards.title: Two-Stage Escalation & 15s Occlusion Window
items: Stage 1 (5s lifetime): R2 warning flags unexpected watch-class object
Stage 2 (30s unattended): R3 critical alarm triggers audio beep and red frame overlay
Tracks survive up to 15s of temporary occlusion before being purged on removal
